newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kharafi in $40 mln construction deal in Kuwait.
newsitem.headline: Kharafi in $40 mln construction deal in Kuwait.

text.p: Kuwait's M.A. Kharafi and Sons has won a $40 million contract for the second phase building of a scientific centre in the Gulf Arab state, industry executives said on Wednesday.

Kuwait's biggest building concern is due to complete next year the $12 million first phase of the project. It is part of major developments by the state to provide entertainment and leisure outlets along the shoreline of the capital.

Kharafi, which has wide operations both in Kuwait and abroad, started work late last year on a 15-storey Kuwait Chamber of Commerce and Industry headquarters in a contract worth $32 million. The building is due for completion on December 31 1999.
